subject.title: fix(plugin-sdk): reject malformed UTF-8 in live provider model catalog responses

question: Should this bounded provider-catalog integrity hardening be accepted after the branch is refreshed against current main and required checks complete?
rationale: The patch has no supported mechanical blocker, but it changes the failure behavior at a plugin-SDK runtime boundary and is already assigned for maintainer review.

options.title: Approve after refresh
options.body: Accept fatal UTF-8 decoding once the current merge result and required checks confirm the focused fallback behavior remains intact.

options.title: Request a targeted follow-up
options.body: Ask for any additional provider-catalog contract coverage only if maintainers want explicit validation of another response shape or runtime consumer.

recommendation.title: Approve after refresh
recommendation.body: Accept fatal UTF-8 decoding once the current merge result and required checks confirm the focused fallback behavior remains intact.
